Needs the live GET to confirm 70/72.

api_key link rows CONFIRMED live: 72 keys, 70 skipped links, exactly ONE key (apk_01KRVSGHN5KMCJSAMMYHRBD42W -> storefront channel) resolves. Latent, storefront unaffected. Prediction of 2 healthy keys was WRONG - only 1. Also found: store_default_sales_channel_id diverges from env_MEDUSA_SALES_CHANNEL_ID, and the diagnostic collapses 'dangling link' and 'no link' into the same empty array.

api_key cleanup APPLIED in prod: 71 revoked + 71 deleted, 72->1 key, 70->0 dangling links. Diagnostic now skipped=0/err=null; storefront smoke identical to baseline (16/16 listings, PDP 200). Took TWO PRs: #119's apply 400'd because Medusa refuses to delete an unrevoked key, and its dry-run had promised an outcome the apply could not deliver; #120 added revoke-then-delete + requires_revoke in the plan.
